title: A pointer click leaves the listbox ringed as if it were focused by keyboard
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page, measuring a headless Chromium render; relayed by the repository owner
details:
A press on a mark focuses the listbox by script. Chrome then matches `:focus-visible` on it, and the ring stays until something else takes focus, though the interaction was a pointer.

The component already tracks the modality, keeping keyboard focus apart from focus in general so that a click does not pin the narration tooltip. The ring should follow the same knowledge: shown for a keyboard focus or a keyboard move, and not for a pointer. The consuming page tracks the last interaction on a wrapper and hides the ring after a pointer.
